meta.description: Visual Popups show people promos, tutorials and announcements with an illustration.

verdict.title: Keep — two layouts, four booleans, three slots
verdict.text: Layout (Centered, Surface), four has… booleans and three slots replace the old Type. Each text layer has its own name, and auto-layout carries the spacing.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Two layouts cover image-led announcements (Centered) and tutorial or carousel popups (Surface); booleans and slots fit each to the content.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own white surface, radius 6, padding and type; the close is a DS Close instance and the action a library Button.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Layout is one clean axis, the booleans follow has…, and each text layer has its own name: #preamble, #title, #message.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Three slots — Image Slot Container, Supporting Content Slot and Action Slot Container — let a product team swap the artwork, add content and set the buttons without detaching.

behavior.notes: Image slot on top (89 tall, empty by default), centred title and message, optional supporting slot, Button in the action slot; Close at the top right.
#F6F9FD card: preamble, title and message beside the Close, then the image slot (radius 6) and the action Button.

resolved.headline: Surface spacer instances removed.
resolved.body: The two _space_16 instances are deleted. The Surface container gap is now space/space-16, and Action Slot Container takes a space/space-8 top padding, so the action still sits 24 below the image. The render is unchanged. (C1)

resolved.headline: Surface preamble renamed #preamble.
resolved.body: The preamble text layer was #message, the same name as the description; #message now names the description only. (C1)

resolved.headline: No interaction states — Visual Popup is a container.
resolved.body: Closed by owner decision. Visual Popup does not need destructive, error or loading states; C5 is Not Applicable. (C5)

accessibility.ios: Present via .sheet or .alert — VoiceOver announces as modal
accessibility.android: Dialog announces as modal; TalkBack focus trapped inside
Automatic with Dialog — set dismissOnClickOutside = false for confirm popups

accessibility.ios: If decorative: .accessibilityHidden(true). If informative: provide a label.
accessibility.android: Same — contentDescription = null for decorative, otherwise describe

accessibility.ios: CTAs use Button which meets HIG 44pt

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Centered for an image-led announcement or promo, with the artwork in the Image slot.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Centered for step-by-step tutorials — Surface carries the preamble and room for a carousel.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Surface for tutorials and guided content, with the step name in the preamble.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t stretch Surface into a long article; link out instead.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep one clear action in the Action slot, with Close for dismissal.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t stack competing primary buttons in the Action slot.

usageGuidelines.doText: Show the close button whenever the popup can be dismissed without acting.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t hide the close button on a promo — the user must always have a way out.

scorecard.notes: Centered: Image Slot Container › body › body container (#title, #message, Supporting Content Slot) › Action Slot Container, Close. Surface: container › heading (#preamble, #title, #message, Close) › Image Slot Container › Action Slot Container, spaced by auto-layout gap.
Layout = Centered, Surface; four has… booleans; three named slots.
Surface bg/color-bg-main and bg/color-bg, title text/color-text, message text/color-text-weaker, preamble text/color-text-weakest, Close text/color-text-weak; the Button is a library instance.
Maps to .sheet / .alert on iOS and Dialog / AlertDialog on Android.
Visual Popup is a container and carries no interaction states (owner decision). Its Close and action Button_New are library instances.
The image is an empty Image Slot Container slot, not a raster; the Close is a DS vector instance.

variants.description: 1 Layout setting × 2 values; the booleans and slots do not multiply the set.

changelog.header: C1 fixes applied in Figma · C5 ruled Not Applicable · node 4120:10317

rows.body: C1 Needs Refinement → Ready. The two _space_16 spacers in Surface are replaced by auto-layout spacing (gap space/space-16, space/space-8 top padding on the action slot), and the preamble is renamed #preamble. Consistent Partial → Pass.
C5 Requires Rework → Not Applicable. Owner decision: Visual Popup does not need interaction states. With C1 Ready and every trait passing, Fix · Requires Rework → Keep · Ready.

changelog.header: Component Review against the Working File rebuild · node 4120:10317

rows.body: Repointed to the rebuild. The owner selected node 4120:10317 (was the assessed copy 18477:23788). Type is replaced by Layout = Centered, Surface, with four booleans and three slots.
Variant naming mixes paradigms. Resolved by the rebuild.
Hero image is a raster placeholder with "Replace me" overlay. Resolved by the rebuild.
Two findings filed (C1). Spacer instances and a duplicate #message name in Surface. Consistent Warn → Partial.
Code tab, Live Preview, Playground and In Context rewritten for the rebuild.
Component assessed — 3 variants (Default / 2 CTA / Version 2). Hero image, title, description, CTA(s). Used for confirms, success states, and onboarding popups. Documented
Variant naming mixes paradigms — Default (generic), 2 CTA (count), Version 2 (version). Should be a single semantic axis (single-cta / dual-cta / dismissible). Open
No destructive/error/loading state — Engineers must improvise these for cancel/delete confirms and async submits. Open
Hero image is a raster placeholder — "Replace me" overlay on a flat Modals Asset image. Should be a swappable Image slot via instance swap. Open
Code Connect mappings — No CLI mappings registered yet. Open
